title: US Revokes Bank-Account Permission for Cuban Private Firms; Díaz-Canel Cries Hypocrisy
detail: New US sanctions revoked the Biden-era permission allowing small Cuban private entrepreneurs to open accounts in US banks. Díaz-Canel, on a podcast with Prime Minister Marrero, said Washington is 'attacking that sector as well', days after Cuba's June reform let private firms hire over 100 workers and trade directly. Independent analysts called it a setback for private enterprise.

media.caption: Díaz-Canel questions US measures over new restrictions on Cuban private firms
